_doc: Fixtures + thresholds for .harmony/probe-seq-vram.sh (s-rta-0928b seqvram). Rows and calibration: the docstring of .harmony/probe-seq-vram.py; plan + Harmony adoption: .harmony/.reports/s-rta-0928b/plan-seqvram.md. Fixture images are generated per run into <out>/media and deleted after the quit.
_minWindowFrames: SeqVram::kMinWindowFrames: a drawn sequence never holds fewer (floors win, H10)
_shownTol: frames-shown delta tolerance around fps x window seconds
_lateMaxAfterJump: a hold of the shown frame for a decode (render frames at 60 Hz), not a freeze
_boxTol: dbox(X, Y): both arrays box-averaged in 16x16 blocks, then mean |diff| over RGB (0..255)
_incomingMinTextures: fix round F7: within 3 s after a fade completes the incoming sequence holds at least this many textures
